scope.item: Fabrication, Supply, Installation and Commissioning of LTCT Panel, Fuse Panel and Distribution Panel for augmentation of power supply to Static Sensors phase II

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate. Tender fee by DD is mentioned but its amount is not printed. EMD validity: English text says 30 days, Hindi text says 90 days from technical bid opening.

eligibility: OEMs or their authorised agents, or appropriate class contractors registered with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL etc or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, having experience in the works
notes: NIT dated 18/07/2024; two-cover online bids. Download/submission 22/07/2024 15:00 to 05/08/2024 14:00; technical bid opening 06/08/2024 15:30. Listing gives bid opening 2024-07-22, which is actually the start of the bid period. Page 3 is blank apart from header and page number (checked by rendering). NIT only; no BOQ, specifications or detailed eligibility. Related earlier tender for similar panels at Deep Bhavan Chennai is nid 1452.
